entries.en: mockery; to mock
entries.notes: 词头 Burbelo 非通行西语词，H 絞糅（或作絞糾）与 M chun chȳ 不相应，四栏无从互证，仅据本页 burla 语义群推定。

entries.en: to scorn; to hold in contempt
to jeer contemptuously; to mock
to jest; to make fun of
entries.notes: H 仅『滚』一字，M 栏作三音节 cǔn cǒg cǔn，疑为『滚笑』一类熟语之截录。

entries.en: to joke; to banter; to make fun of
to make sport of; to fool
entries.notes: L 栏 vuihan 疑讹（bruhan/burlan），M 栏另出 lâng cun 未能对上，义据 H『弄』与 R lōng。

entries.en: to play tricks on; to tease
to tease; to make fun of; to toy with a lover
entries.notes: L 栏 enamorade 疑为 enamorada；M 栏 hí cai 之末一音节未详。

entries.en: to make sport of; to jest with
to banter; to jest at
entries.notes: H 第二字疑为譚/談（或本作謔），M 栏并存两读，义取『戏谑』。

entries.en: to dally amorously with; to trifle with a lover
entries.notes: H 第二字疑为姦/姣，皆指狎昵，与 L 栏 los enamorade 相合。

entries.en: to mock ironically; to jeer
entries.notes: H 首字疑为挸/挩，音义难定；义据 L 栏 irónica mente（讥讽地）。

entries.en: to mock ironically; to jeer and tease
entries.notes: 同前条，H 首字疑挸/挩而次字『弄』明，义据 L 栏 ironica mte。

entries.en: to roll one's eyes (in mockery)
entries.notes: T99 仅污损调符；目白之动作与 L 栏 gestos con los ojos 互证，释义可定。

entries.en: to stick out one's tongue (in mockery)
entries.notes: M 栏末音节 chgui 难辨、调符 T99 污损，然 H『舌吐』与 L 栏 sacando la lengua 相合。

entries.zh: 侮弄；欺侮戏弄（亦指好嘲弄之人）
entries.en: to mock and insult; (as noun) a mocker
entries.notes: L 栏兼举动词与名词 burlón；M 栏混入西语 Bufar、R 栏多出 cūn，栏位有窜行，不影响释义。

entries.en: to jest; to mock
entries.notes: H『合滚』非通行语，M/R 同为 cóg cùn 而义难通，仅据西语 Burlarse 定大意。

entries.en: to mock in words; jeering talk
to mock; to make fun of
entries.notes: H『当酒』与 M hōng zoà tǒg、R hāng zā 均难通，仅据西语词头 Burlar 定大意。

entries.en: to jeer with words; to mock verbally
entries.notes: H『打口鼓』为方言性说法（鼓舌嘲弄），M/R 末音节对音零乱。

entries.zh: 侮弄尊长；对长辈不敬地戏弄
entries.en: to mock one's elders; to treat seniors with disrespect
